fact: At an AI governance seminar on 21 May 2026 a Seychelles MP presented the Data Protection Act 2023 and the Cybercrime and Other Related Crimes Act 2021 as the country's recent steps towards AI governance, with no AI-specific law mentioned.
title: Seychelles Presides Over Plenary Meeting Of The L'association Des Parlements Des Etats Membres De La COI In Madagascar
